verdict.rationale: Asana documents a public RESTful API with resource-oriented URLs and JSON requests and responses. It also provides an in-context API explorer, a published OpenAPI specification, official JavaScript and Python client libraries, a token-based quick start, webhooks, and a documented deprecation process with Asana-Change headers. An official MCP server adds agent-facing access on top of the API. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec at the standard well-known URLs on the docs domain (the spec is published on GitHub instead).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Asana API is a RESTful interface with predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON or form-encoded requests, returns JSON
Each API endpoint features a built-in, in-context API explorer through which you can make requests (and see responses).
This repository contains the [OpenAPI Specification](https://swagger.io/specification/) for Asana's APIs.
Learn to create and authorize with a token then create tasks via the API.
The official libraries available are listed below: JavaScript, Python
